hero.description: Dexorium is the reference desk for players, collectors and competitive trainers: species, moves, abilities, items, locations, evolution chains and team tools — all embedded in a native application that works in a plane, at a tournament or in a room with no Wi-Fi.

foundation.title: A native shell, a trustworthy core
foundation.description: The project is structured around strict dependency rules so features can grow without turning the codebase into a monolith.

shell.title: Native Tauri shell
shell.description: Lightweight system WebView, signed installers and a strict content security policy from day one.

rust.title: Layered Rust core
rust.description: pdx-domain, pdx-app and pdx-infra keep business rules pure and isolate every I/O concern.

ipc.title: Typed IPC bridge
ipc.description: Tauri commands stay thin, return typed payloads and are reached through a single Angular facade.

ui.title: Angular 20 interface
ui.description: Standalone components, signals, zoneless change detection and runtime language switching.

data.title: Local SQLite storage
data.description: A read-only reference database is separated from user data, so dataset updates never touch your collection.

offline.title: Offline by design
offline.description: No account, no telemetry and no silent network calls. Everything you need ships with the application.

roadmap.title: From foundation to full Pokédex
roadmap.description: The first release focuses on a complete, instant Pokédex. Competitive and collection tools follow in incremental milestones.

mvp.title: Offline Pokédex MVP
mvp.description: Species and forms, stats, types, evolution chains, learnsets, global search, filters, light/dark themes and FR/EN localization.

v11.title: Data & comfort
v11.description: Abilities, items, saved filters, species comparison, export, shortcuts and update checks on demand.

v12.title: Competitive toolkit
v12.description: Damage and stat calculators, team builder, type coverage, speed tiers, locations and Showdown import/export.
